_readme: Videos shown on videos.html. Add a new upload as one entry: id = the YouTube video id, format = "video" (16:9) or "short" (9:16). paper.title must match the paper's "name" in academic-publications.json to show a Video button on the Publications page. A video without a paper can have a short "note" instead.

videos.title: ACML: Model Reality. Build What's Next.
videos.summary: A short film about the lab: the questions we model, the tools we build, and the partners we build them with.

videos.title: Mismatched Socks, Explained by Math (and One Very Lonely Sock)
videos.summary: Should you wear mismatched socks? Lefty the orphan sock and our narrator walk through the model, the user study and the simulations.

paper.title: Service Preservation from Matching Non-Matching Socks Under Stochastic Loss
paper.label: Explore the study

videos.title: A Ball That Bounces Back Up Underwater? AI Found the Missing Force
videos.summary: A ball sinking through two layered liquids can drift back up at the boundary. Physics-informed AI found the missing force: a delayed kick that fades as it wobbles.

paper.title: Physics-informed symbolic regression reveals a delayed oscillatory closure for particle–interface dynamics

videos.title: Can the Shape of Your Family Tree Predict How Relatives Feel?
videos.summary: From the shape of a family tree alone, a graph AI predicted how satisfied relatives are with each other, off by about 0.3 points on a 10-point scale for close family.

paper.title: The topology of a family tree graph and its members’ satisfaction with one another: a machine learning approach

videos.title: Can You Invest in Research Like a Stock Portfolio?
videos.summary: Planning a department's research like an investment portfolio: our DEPO algorithm stayed within about 4% of the top earner and kept the portfolio broad when the budget crashed.

paper.title: A Portfolio-Theoretic Algorithm for Institutional Research Planning Under Scientometric Objectives

videos.title: Systemic Sclerosis in Silico: Why Spaced Shots Beat a Daily Pill (in Our Model)
videos.summary: In a model of skin scarring in systemic sclerosis, small TGF-beta-blocking shots every three weeks beat a daily cell-killing pill.

paper.title: Mathematical Modeling of Systemic Sclerosis and Its Treatment

videos.title: A Fairer Way to Fund the UN? In Our Model, Every Country Gains
videos.summary: If each country paid in line with what it gets, our model of 138 UN member states raised global benefit by about 6%, and every country gained.

paper.title: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Framework for Sustainable UN Financing: An Application to Global Public Goods Provision

videos.title: The Shadow Economy in Sweden: Geography Matters
videos.summary: Follow the cash: modelling Sweden's informal economy region by region, and why a region's neighbours help predict it.

paper.title: Tell Me Who Your Neighbors Are and I Will Tell You Your Informal Economy Size: The Case of Sweden

videos.title: Symbolic Distillation in Neural Networks
videos.summary: Opening the black box: distilling a trained neural network into equations people can read.

paper.title: Interpretable knowledge distillation via symbolic regression for feedforward neural networks

videos.title: Can We Really Map Pandemics to Graphs?
videos.summary: Turning detailed spatial epidemic models into graphs that keep most of the accuracy for a fraction of the computing time.

paper.title: Transforming norm-based to graph-based spatial representation for spatio-temporal epidemiological models

videos.title: Asimov's Laws in Reinforcement Learning
videos.summary: Can a robot that learns from reward follow Asimov's three laws? On encoding priorities into reinforcement learning.
videos.note: Concept explainer, not based on a single paper

videos.title: Agentic AI Shops Like Humans When It's Stressed
videos.summary: After hearing traumatic stories, LLM shopping agents fill their carts less healthily, mirroring a human stress bias.

paper.title: Inducing state anxiety in LLM agents reproduces human-like biases in consumer decision-making

videos.title: German-Israeli Foundation Bridges: Do They Really Work?
videos.summary: Do bi-national research grants build lasting collaborations? What 642 grants and almost four decades of papers show.

paper.title: Bi-national academic funding and collaboration dynamics: the case of the German-Israeli foundation

videos.title: Can We Build Drones That Fly Like Moths?
videos.summary: How a moth tracks a scent through turbulent air, captured in an exploration-exploitation model of navigation.

paper.title: Exploration-Exploitation Model of Moth-Inspired Olfactory Navigation
paper.venue: Journal of the Royal Society Interface, 2024

videos.title: The Mathematics of Snails vs Coffee Rust
videos.summary: Can snails protect coffee trees from leaf rust? A mathematical model of living biological control.

paper.title: Mathematical model of coffee tree’s rust control using snails as biological agents
